title: Odd or Even Check
statement:
Given an integer `n` (it may be negative or zero), decide whether it is **even** or **odd**.

An integer is even if it is divisible by `2` and odd otherwise. Zero is even. Print `Even` or `Odd`.

Be careful with negative numbers: in several languages the remainder of a negative number divided by `2` is `-1`, not `1`.

examples.explanation: -9 is not divisible by 2. In C++ and Java, -9 % 2 is -1, so compare the remainder with 0 rather than with 1.

hints: What remainder do even numbers leave when divided by 2?
Do not test `n % 2 == 1`: it fails for negative numbers in some languages.
Test `n % 2 == 0` for even and treat everything else as odd (or look at the lowest bit).
